selection_rationale: A uniform fast (1.5g) gun line of battlecruisers maximizes firepower-per-point while keeping a single consistent speed doctrine, letting the fleet dictate engagement range against slower capitals and concentrate 6 spinal coilers plus 12 PD lasers for mutual torpedo defense.
formation_rationale: A compact 3D diamond/wedge keeps all six battlecruisers within ~90 km of each other for overlapping point-defense coverage against torpedo salvos, while the lead ship draws first fire and the staggered lateral/vertical offsets complicate enemy spinal-weapon geometry (no clean line-up of multiple hulls). The rear ship acts as a reserve to exploit openings or cover a retreat.
